description: Space Odysseys is a student team passionate about technology, education, and space exploration. I’m Jahid Hasan, the Team Leader, interested in web development, programming, and UI/UX. Our team member Afroza Binte Ansarul is interested in creative content and digital media. We welcome teammates interested in space science, research, web development, design, video editing, data analysis, and storytelling.
summary: EXOARCHIVE is an interactive digital museum dedicated to preserving the stories of human-made machines left on the Moon and Mars. Developed by Team Space Odysseys from Mymensingh, Bangladesh, the project explores 20 historic space machines through interactive NASA Moon Trek and Mars Trek maps, detailed mission dossiers, and live data from JPL Horizons. Users can discover the history, missions, achievements, and final status of these machines through an engaging digital experience. EXOARCHIVE also features immersive Moon and Mars sound experiences, educational activities, interactive quizzes, and bilingual learning support in English and Bangla. By transforming space exploration history into an accessible and interactive learning experience, EXOARCHIVE helps students and future explorers understand humanity's journey beyond Earth and ensures that these forgotten machines are never forgotten.
details:
EXOARCHIVE works as an interactive digital museum where users can explore 20 human-made machines left on the Moon and Mars. The platform presents each machine through a dedicated mission dossier containing its history, mission objectives, achievements, and current status. Users can explore planetary locations through NASA's Moon Trek and Mars Trek mapping resources and access live astronomical information using NASA JPL Horizons data.

The platform includes an interactive exploration experience, educational quizzes, Young Explorers activities, Match the Machine challenges, and Build a Mission activities. It supports both English and Bangla to make space education accessible to a wider audience. Offline accessibility is also considered to support learning in areas with limited internet connectivity.

The project was developed using modern web technologies and AI-assisted development tools. Its creative approach combines space history, interactive storytelling, scientific data, and gamified education in one digital platform.

The primary goal is to preserve the legacy of forgotten space exploration machines, inspire young learners, and make planetary science more engaging and accessible.
